Description.description: A description for the option set.

DisplayName.description: A label containing the display name for the global option set.

ExternalTypeName.description: The external type name of the option set metadata base.

HasChanged.description: Indicates whether the item of metadata has changed.

IntroducedVersion.description: A string identifying the solution version that the solution component was added in.

IsCustomizable.description: Whether the option set is customizable.

IsCustomOptionSet.description: Whether the option set is a custom option set.

IsGlobal.description: Whether the option set is a global option set.

IsManaged.description: Whether the option set is part of a managed solution.

MetadataId.description: A unique identifier for the metadata item.

Name.description: The name of a global option set.
